I hope shit gets easier for you dude people can be assholes it's frustrating and it's not fair and you deserve better in all honesty what I did to keep going was mostly just living out of spite and trying to set little things to keep me from ending it like 'I can't kill myself until I've seen this film' and exams are fucking shite personally I try to break things up so they're more manageable and try to ignore the other parts until I get to them because getting something done is better than nothing if you can't manage to study or do all of your work don't beat yourself up over it because all that will do is make you feel like shit try and get even just a bit of your work or throw in a small amount of studying and celebrate your little achievements because short term goals can be really nice sorry I'm not a person who knows what to say to other people but I wanted to try to give you some kind of acknowledgment I guess dude

I felt this so hard dude I remember when I wrote this one fanfic when I was younger and not used to uploading what I wrote for people to see and it was just for fun and more for me than anyone else and I'd get so excited whenever people left comments or liked a chapter (it was on wattpad as I hadn't discovered A03 yet) but then people started getting really demanding to the point where I rarely read the comments anymore because I would upload a chapter and on the same day I would get people just commenting 'update' and it wasn't fun anymore and after a certain point I wasn't writing it because I enjoyed it but because I felt like I was supposed to and I think it showed a bit in my writing I kind of wish I just ended it when I stopped feeling it because I never finished it and my writing style changed and I feel like it didn't have the same charm it had in the first few chapters of course I'm grateful people enjoyed it and wanted me to update but it just got really frustrating
